findings.cause: The worst red (x -0.64..-0.34 H, y 0.31..0.46 H) is a big wedge above and behind the rump. The rear lathe plus the straight, horizontal tail spike stick out past the sheet, where the tail rises in a curve instead. RTS spill is 24% and IoU is 0.700, right on the 0.70 gate.
findings.fix: Slim spine.1 (radius about 0.9). Re-pose tail.1 so it rises up and back instead of pointing straight out. Its chain is at [0,0,0], which looks like a placeholder root.

findings.cause: Red past the muzzle and the ear on the right. The head plates (head#3 is 0.43 tall) are too tall and too far forward for the 3/4 read.
findings.fix: Shrink head#3 in y (about 0.9) and pull the head back slightly.

findings.cause: The tow rope loop lying on the ground behind the dog is all green. The only rope is a 0.03 straight prism at ground level, so it gives no silhouette.
findings.fix: Model the rope as a visible path from the harness to the ground plus a loop behind the hind legs, not a hairline prism.

findings.cause: Uncovered share is 0.171. The green arc from the chest harness down under the belly, and the rope trailing along the ground to the right, are missing. leg3.lower#1 is too thin and short to register.
findings.fix: Thicken and lengthen the rope. Add a ground segment behind the hind feet and a hanging segment from spine.2's harness.
